geometry_stats.fitted_on: all coordinate training valid nodes only
geometry_stats.statistics_input: cached float32 geometry converted to float64
geometry_stats.neighbor_policy: exclude self/padding; include all kth-distance ties; use all when fewer than k

optimizer: CatBoost Plain GPU boosting, not SGD
checkpoint_rule: strict minimum full VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct over a single common tree count for all18 tasks; first wins ties
inference_rule: one global VAL-selected tree count for the complete18 bank; native legal pool; stable ascending-global-solver-ID ties
source_plan: full TRAIN table per task for boosting; no shuffled SGD minibatches or neural initialization
gradients: not applicable: independent GPU tree fitting, no neural minibatches
train_eval: full18 VAL every100 common trees after each task finishes3000; full TRAIN only at selected common count
test: one full TEST after unique VAL-best lock; saved predictions reusable
test_rnd_disclosure: TEST informed earlier R&D; preserved old holdouts plus previously unused input-stratified extensions
nss_reference: locked R79 weights, fresh predictions on the same new4500 TEST; no NSS retraining

A.mechanism: input-only hard32/8 hierarchical directed graph encoder

C.mechanism: full18 GPU CatBoost native-winner classification bank

D.mechanism: full18 GPU CatBoost legal-pool relative-regret MultiRMSE bank

record.candidate_policy: unchanged frozen NEW90k release: B filtering; MOEL renamed reld_mt; never restore MTL
record.selection: strict minimum full18 VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct; TRAIN-fitted SBS; first ties
record.tree_selection: one common tree count across all18 task models; no per-task best assembly
record.test_policy: unique VAL lock before TEST and LIB; TEST is development-exposed, not a new blind holdout
record.acceptance: full18 Top1 strictly higher and mean_cost/actual_regret nonincreasing on VAL; report same-lock TEST/LIB and fixed target36 recovery/false picks; no zero-count-only success
record.evidence_boundary: A/B coarsening control includes fixed B structural regularizers. C/D are independent model-family experiments with boosting budgets, not matched neural compute. Not full original DiffPool or ordered CatBoost reproduction.

historical_reference.evidence: historical same-data reference, not equal-parameter/equal-compute control

evidence_boundary: Independent input-derived tree selector family. Eighteen task-specific banks share one global VAL-selected tree count, not per-task best assembly. Compute budget is not matched to neural arms.

feature_definition.quantiles: linear interpolation over valid nodes only
feature_definition.geometry: existing 12-channel R84 cached local geometry; no normalization/refitting
feature_definition.xy: inertia/covariance/eigenvalues, bounding-box-normalized grid4x4, angle8 at centroid/depot
feature_definition.correlations: all pairs of x/y/demand/service/TW endpoints/width/centroid radius/depot radius
feature_definition.matrix: directed row/column mean/min/std; absolute/relative asymmetry; nearest 1/4/8 means
feature_definition.matrix_diagonal: excluded from all edge statistics, including nearest neighbors
feature_definition.missing_channels: zero; kind/d_in/depot flags distinguish absent attributes
feature_definition.padding: excluded, even when padding contains NaN/Inf

tree_selection: ONE common ntree_end for the entire full18 bank; strict full18 VAL macro_vs_sbs_pct; first exact tie
tree_training: full-dataset boosting; no SGD minibatches; not budget-matched to NN updates
tree_targets: FP32((raw FP64 legal costs - per-row FP64 minimum) / per-row FP64 minimum)
tree_inference: argmin predicted relative regret; no observed costs or Oracle at inference
tree_cost_normalizer: TRAIN labels only, per-row legal minimum; no feature normalization from labels
